chat.label: Chat: agent transcript, composer, queue, attachments, models, turn controls

diff.label: Diff viewer: changed files, file diff rendering, navigation, inline and GitHub review comments

pr.label: PR area: create, status, checks, merge, review and conflict flows

features.title: Start an agent session in a workspace and stream its messages into the transcript
features.why: sendReason (reasonChat.ts:90) invokes the registered reason_open_chat and reason_prompt and streams events; #301 adds review chats as separate Reason Sessions and surfaces unoffered config as a notice. Still Reason-only (no Claude Code/Codex command), the transcript is an in-memory Map, and the main chat sends config [] because configureReason is called only for review chats (ReviewButton.tsx:74), so #271 stays open.
features.obligation: Run the main chat on the selected agent, model and effort (#271), and persist sessions and session_messages so transcripts survive a restart.

features.title: Render assistant messages as markdown with highlighted code blocks
features.why: Transcript.tsx Part still renders text as a plain div ('Message text is shown as plain pre-wrapped text; markdown rendering is a separate slice'). package.json has no markdown or highlight dependency. The reference chat--transcript-collapsed-tools shows inline code chips and lists.
features.obligation: Render assistant text blocks as markdown with inline code, lists and syntax-highlighted code blocks.

features.title: Show agent tool calls as collapsible rows with a setting to keep them expanded
features.why: Reason tool_call / tool_call_update events (reason_acp/updates.rs -> reason.ts) reach Transcript.tsx ToolRow as collapsible per-tool rows. Transcript accepts expandToolsByDefault (view.ts isToolExpanded) but WorkspaceView never passes it and no settings page has the keep-expanded toggle; there is no grouped 'N tool calls, M messages' header as in chat--tool-calls-expanded.
features.obligation: Group consecutive tool calls and intermediate text under one collapsible 'N tool calls, M messages' header, and add the keep-expanded setting wired to expandToolsByDefault.

features.title: Composer that sends a message, with a configurable send key
features.why: The ChatPanel composer sends real turns through sendReason (reason_prompt). Its textarea onKeyDown hard-codes Enter/Shift+Enter; SEND_KEY_PRESETS and chat.submitMessage in keybindings/registry.ts are used only inside src/keybindings and no settings page offers a send-key choice. The reference composer's model chip, attach button and focus hint are absent, and the selected model/effort never reach the agent (#271).
features.obligation: Drive submit/newline from the chat.submitMessage / chat.newLine keybindings with a send-key setting, and add the reference composer controls (model chip, attach, focus hint) with the chosen model and effort passed to the agent.

features.title: Queue messages while a turn runs: edit, delete, reorder, steer, pause and resume the queue
features.why: No queue state, component or command. A message sent mid-turn goes straight to reason_prompt and reason.ts closes the oldest open turn as superseded. Nothing outside migrations reads or writes session_messages.queue_order or sessions.queue_paused_at; chat.queue.* / chat.queueEdit.* exist only as hidden keybinding entries with no handlers.
features.obligation: Queue composer messages while a turn runs, with edit, delete, reorder, steer, pause and resume UI, persisted to queue_order / queue_paused_at, and bind the chat.queue.* keybindings.

features.title: Stop a running turn and mark cancelled messages
features.why: When transcript.activeTurn is set, ChatPanel shows a Stop button. It calls stopReason, which invokes reason_cancel (registered), and ReasonProvider::cancel sends session/cancel. The turn ends 'cancelled' and the footer shows 'Stopped.' with Retry. No message gets cancelledAt or session_messages.cancelled_at, and Stop does not exist for the Claude Code or Codex runners.
features.obligation: Mark the cancelled turn's messages with cancelled_at (persisted and rendered, as in the 'request cancelled' copy) and wire Stop to the Claude Code and Codex runners.

features.title: Draft attachments in the composer (files, images, terminal output) that materialize on send
features.why: #301 sends attachments to reason_prompt as ACP resource blocks (provider.rs:442) and shows 'Attached: <name>' lines; sources are only the discard revert note and the review prompt. draftAttachmentsApi is imported by nothing; no attach button, Cmd+U, file/image/paste, and attachments.is_draft is never written.
features.obligation: Mount draft attachments in the composer (attach button, Cmd+U, drag/paste of files, images and terminal output) on draftAttachmentsApi, show chips, and materialize them on send into the prompt, recorded with attachments.is_draft.

features.title: Model picker with favorites and per-session thinking/effort level
features.why: Settings › Default models (settings/DefaultModelsPage.tsx) saves models.default, and CreateWorkspaceDialog builds firstSession {agent, model, effort} from it. seedTranscript and sendReason forward only the message text, so the chosen model and effort never reach a running agent. There is no composer picker like menu--model-picker's 'Opus 5 High' chip, no favorites, and no per-session effort, and chat.openModelPicker has no handler.
features.obligation: Add the composer model picker with favorites and per-session effort, persisted to sessions (claude_effort_level, codex_thinking_level), and pass the model and effort into the agent launch.

features.title: Plan mode: enter, exit, and approve the agent's plan
features.why: PermissionMode::Plan exists only in agent/claude_cli.rs launch args, and no registered command launches Claude. chat.togglePlanMode and chat.approvePlan are keybinding registry entries with no handler, and no plan approval UI exists. Default to plan mode is explicitly omitted from DefaultModelsPage.
features.obligation: Add a plan-mode toggle to the composer (Shift+Tab), pass it to the agent launch, and show the plan review/approve step in the transcript.
anchors: copy /review and approve the plan/ (2 hits)

features.title: Context window usage meter and compaction
features.why: No code reads or shows context usage or compaction. reason_acp/updates.rs parse_update explicitly returns None for usage updates, and sessions.context_used_percent and is_compacting are schema only.
features.obligation: Show a per-session context window usage meter and compaction state, fed by agent usage events.

features.title: Per-message actions: copy, edit and resend, retry, fork the chat
features.why: Copy, Copy final message, Retry and Reset chat unchanged; finished turns now show TurnChanges file chips that open the turn's diff. Edit-and-resend, Fork chat and the duration/time chips are still missing.
features.obligation: Add edit-and-resend and 'Fork chat' (a registered fork command creating a session from a turn), plus the footer's duration, time and changed-files chips.

features.title: Several chat sessions per workspace as tabs, with titles and unread counts
features.why: MainTabs in WorkspaceView.tsx renders one chat tab titled with the workspace name (plus the 'All changes' diff tab), and the chat id is the workspace id. There is no '+', and no multiple sessions or per-session titles. Workspace.unread is read by Sidebar.tsx but nothing sets it.
features.obligation: Support several chat sessions per workspace as tabs, with a '+' button, session titles and unread counts, backed by sessions rows.

features.title: Revert the workspace to the checkpoint taken at a turn
features.why: Checkpoints moved to the backend (turn_checkpoint::around_turn in reason_prompt) and turn ids are now chatId:uuid, removing the cross-run ref collision. Reset chat still truncates only the in-memory transcript; nothing is persisted and the agent session is not rewound.
features.obligation: Persist turns in session_messages (turn_id) and delete messages after the watermark in storage, rewind or re-seed the agent session, use stable unique turn ids for checkpoint refs, and apply checkpointing to the Claude Code and Codex runners.
anchors: copy /later messages will be deleted/ (1 hit)

features.title: Dictate a message with speech-to-text
features.why: No dictation or speech code exists in src/ or src-tauri/src (ledger agent.speech).
features.obligation: Add speech-to-text dictation into the composer.

features.title: Find text in the chat transcript
features.why: The only find bar is features/terminal/FindBar.tsx, which covers terminals. chat.search, searchNext and searchPrevious exist only as keybinding registry entries with no handler, and the transcript has no find UI.
features.obligation: Add find-in-transcript (top-level messages) bound to chat.search, with next/previous match navigation.

features.title: List changed files for uncommitted and all-branch changes with per-file status
features.why: ChangesList is mounted with real diff_workspace data and now has a context menu (View, Copy path, Copy relative path, Discard). 'All changes' still diffs against repo.defaultBranch (WorkspaceView.tsx:316) instead of the workspace target ref, and workspace.showUncommittedChanges is bound nowhere.
features.obligation: Diff 'All changes' against the workspace target ref (origin/<target branch>) and bind workspace.showUncommittedChanges to open the list in Uncommitted scope.

features.title: Render a file diff with syntax highlighting (reference uses the Pierre diff renderer)
features.why: FileDiffView.tsx renders the selected file as a Pierre @pierre/diffs CodeView item with the options in evidence/frontend/pierre-diff-options.md (disableFileHeader, line-info-basic, expansionLineCount 20, loadDiffFiles over diff_workspace with WHOLE_FILE_CONTEXT, lineHoverHighlight number). Since #296 DiffWorkerPool wraps the app in Pierre's WorkerPoolContextProvider (poolSize 2, shiki-wasm, preloaded languages, theme sync), matching Conductor. Only nit: a status letter where the reference has a file-type icon.
anchors: copy /failed to load file diff/ (2 hits)

features.title: Toggle split and unified diff layouts
features.why: #331 changed LAYOUT_TITLE to Conductor's 'Unified view' / 'Split view' / 'Entire file' (DiffViewer.tsx:30), closing the only gap. LayoutToggle drives Pierre diffStyle and persists in openconductor.diff.options.

features.title: Virtualize long file lists and large diffs
features.why: Since #282 FileDiffView renders the open file as the single item of a Pierre CodeView in a fixed-height .oc-code-view scroller, so only rows near the viewport render and revealLine scrolls unrendered lines into view. That is what evidence/frontend/pierre-diff-options.md records for Conductor (one-item CodeView per open file). The same evidence shows no windowing on Conductor's Changes list, so the unvirtualized ChangesList matches (inferred from the bundle).

features.title: Show or hide whitespace-only changes
features.why: #331 removed the ChangesList checkbox; DiffTab mounts ViewOptionsMenu (DiffViewer.tsx:89-92) with checkbox items 'Hide whitespace changes' and 'Wrap lines' (Whitespace.tsx:33,42-83) on the same ignoreWhitespace flag, matching evidence/diff/whitespace.md:45-56. The #270 fix and the WhitespaceOnly state are intact.

features.title: Mark files as viewed
features.why: #331 replaced the checkbox with ViewedToggle (FileDiffView.tsx:211,219-235): a ghost button, aria-pressed, tooltip 'Mark as viewed' / 'Mark as not viewed' plus the diff.toggleViewed shortcut (evidence/diff/whitespace.md:60-62). Fingerprinted marks, N/M count and 'Next unread' unchanged.

features.title: Keyboard navigation to the next/previous file and comment in a diff
features.why: #304 mounted the floating buttons: FileDiffView.tsx:90 calls useCommentNavigation, :161 renders CommentNav, :136 refreshes counts after render. CommentNav shows 'Previous comment'/'Next comment' with counts only when count > 0 and binds diff.previousComment/nextComment at higher priority (evidence/diff/comment-navigation.md). File navigation unchanged.

features.title: Show the changes made in a selected agent turn, cached locally
features.why: reason_prompt wraps the turn in around_turn and returns turnChanges (reason_chat.rs:121-127), with checkpoint_turn_changes (lib.rs:314) as fallback; TurnChanges chips under each finished turn open the file in Turn scope and an empty turn shows 'No changes in selected turn.'. Turn ids are random per run so restored turns lose chips, the cache is webview localStorage not db.local-storage, and the chip layout shows 2 + more where evidence says the first 3.
features.obligation: Persist turn ids with the transcript, move the cache to the db.local-storage subsystem, and settle the 2-vs-3 chip count against REA evidence.

features.title: Discard changes to one file or all files after confirmation
features.why: The revert note reaches the composer after a discard and since #301 goes to Reason as an embedded attachment. The context-menu 'Discard changes' still calls diff.askDiscard unconditionally (ChangesList.tsx:123), even in the turn view where canDiscard is false, and discards against the current scope (useWorkspaceDiff.ts:116) instead of always 'All changes'.
features.obligation: Make the context-menu discard always use 'All changes' and hide or refuse it while a turn is selected.

features.title: Add, edit and delete inline comments on a line or line range
features.why: #330 passes enableGutterUtility, enableLineSelection and controlled selectedLines to CodeView (FileDiffView.tsx:106-128,157-158); the selected range opens the composer and is saved as line_number/end_line_number through the registered diff_comment_add (ReviewComments.tsx:247,278; comments.ts:69-75), as evidence/diff/wrap-lines-and-range-comments.md describes.

features.title: Send review comments to the agent chat as attachments
features.why: toChat still pastes formatForAgent text and calls diff_comments_mark_sent (ReviewComments.tsx:191-194); the button reads 'Add N comments to chat'. #301 added a composer attachment path (sendReason takes PromptAttachment[]) that comments do not use, and inserts now go to whichever chat is showing, including a review chat (WorkspaceView.tsx:366).
features.obligation: Attach comments as composer attachments carrying comment_id instead of pasting text, use 'Add all comments to chat', and decide whether they go to the workspace chat rather than a visible review chat.
anchors: copy /add all comments to chat/ (2 hits)

features.title: Sync PR review comments from GitHub with resolved, outdated and suggestion state
features.why: Only the schema columns and DTO fields exist (`remote_url`, `is_outdated`, `is_resolved`, `suggestion_base_code` in comment_commands.rs `CommentDto` and the db crate), plus a GitHub link and an 'Outdated' tag in `CommentItem`. `refreshOutdated` is purely local. Nothing in src-tauri fetches PR review comments (no `pulls/{n}/comments` or `reviewThreads`).
features.obligation: Sync PR review comments from GitHub into diff_comments with resolved, outdated and suggestion state, and show them in the diff.

features.title: Edit a file from the diff viewer
features.why: There is no editor in the diff tab and no file-write command. The reference copy 'Edit in diff viewer' appears nowhere in src.
features.obligation: Let the user edit the file from the diff viewer and save it to the worktree, then refresh the diff.

features.title: Diff font, ligatures, syntax theme and colour-vision themes
features.why: Code theme (useDiffTheme), fonts, ligatures and color_vision are in place; #331 moved 'Wrap lines' into View options. wrapLines is still stored in the localStorage diff options (types.ts:47-51), not Conductor's wrap_lines settings row.
features.obligation: Store wrap lines as the wrap_lines setting (default true) through get_settings/update_settings.
anchors: copy /font used for code and diffs/ (4 hits)

features.title: Create a pull request or draft PR from a workspace, persisting title and description
features.why: usePrActions.create (usePrActions.ts:80) sends only {branch, remote, targetBranch, draft} to the registered pr_create_prompt; the createPR custom prompt (now readable via db_repo_prompt) and the PR template are not passed, and pr_title/pr_description are not written to conductor.db.
features.obligation: Read the repo's custom_prompt_create_pr and PR template and pass them to pr_create_prompt. Save the PR title and body to workspaces.pr_title and pr_description through a registered command when the lookup finds the PR.

features.title: Per-repository prompts for create PR, code review, fix errors, resolve conflicts, rename branch
features.why: #301 registered db_repo_prompt (persistence_commands.rs; lib.rs:296), reading all six custom_prompt_* kinds; the running app reads codeReview for the Review button (reviewApi.ts:9). There is no UI to edit any prompt, and createPR, fixErrors, resolveMergeConflicts, renameBranch and general are read nowhere.
features.obligation: Add per-repo prompt editing through a registered write command, and read createPR, fixErrors, resolveMergeConflicts and renameBranch in their flows.

features.title: PR status in the workspace header (draft, open, review required, changes requested, merged)
features.why: usePullRequest polls the registered pr_lookup, pr_git_state and pr_header_state every 30 s and after agent turns, and control.ts prControl maps every HeaderAction (loading_pr, draft_pr, changes_requested, review_required, merged, queued_to_merge, checks states) to header labels covering the reference copy anchors. pr_lookup's derivedStatus is dropped (the chip still shows workspace.status) and never stored; lookups run only for the open workspace; hasPendingComments and optionalChecksBlock are hard-coded false.
features.obligation: Store pr_lookup's derivedStatus (and PR title/description) per workspace, poll every workspace in a batch, and feed the real pending-comment flag and optional-checks-blocking setting into header_state.

features.title: CI checks list with logs, re-run failed, and optional-checks policy
features.why: The Checks tab is mounted in RightPanel (WorkspaceView.tsx:244-251) with live pr_lookup rollup data; checks/api.ts calls the registered pr_check_log and pr_rerun_failed_checks (lib.rs:362-363), and ChecksTab re-runs and fetches logs. The 'Treat optional checks as blocking' setting is saved but never read (usePullRequest.ts:65 hard-codes optionalChecksBlock: false), and 'Fix errors' is not built.
features.obligation: Read treat_optional_checks_as_blocking in usePullRequest; add 'Fix errors' sending failing logs to the agent; show Re-run whenever a failing check has a details URL (evidence/pr/NOTES.md:32).
anchors: copy /failed to fetch check logs/ (1 hit)
copy /treat optional checks as blocking/ (1 hit)

features.title: Merge a PR (merge, squash, rebase), merge queue and automerge
features.why: On ready_to_merge PrControl shows Merge, calling the registered pr_merge through usePrActions.merge; the tooltip names the repo merge method from pr_merge_method, git.mergePR works through mergeShortcutApplies, and queued_to_merge shows 'In merge queue', matching NOTES (the reference has no method menu either). Automerge has no UI: api.ts setAutoMerge wraps pr_set_auto_merge but nothing calls it. The optional-checks-as-blocking setting does not exist. shortcuts.ts canMerge re-implements Rust merge_eligibility::can_merge by hand and can drift.
features.obligation: Add the automerge control calling pr_set_auto_merge and the 'treat optional checks as blocking' setting, feeding header_state and the merge shortcut; use the Rust eligibility result for the shortcut.

features.title: Archive the workspace when its PR merges
features.why: Settings > Git has an 'Archive on merge' row (GitPage.tsx:101-109); useArchiveOnMerge (WorkspaceView.tsx:320-328, usePullRequest.ts:72) archives through the registered db_archive_workspace when mergedTransition/archiveDecision agree. Only the open workspace is watched, there is no per-repo override, the toast has no Open PR/Unarchive, and db_archive_workspace only flips the row (no archive_commit, worktree kept).
features.obligation: Watch every workspace's PR state, add the per-repo override, toast actions, full archive (archive_commit + worktree cleanup) and the stacked-PR exception.

features.title: Commit and push all workspace changes
features.why: No commit-and-push function or command exists in src-tauri, and none of the registered commands commits or pushes. header.rs only has a CommitAndPush HeaderAction enum value, and the `git.commitAndPush` keybinding in registry.ts has no handler.
features.obligation: Implement a commit-and-push-all command, or the agent prompt the reference uses, and wire it to the header CommitAndPush action and the git.commitAndPush keybinding.
anchors: copy /commit and push all changes/ (2 hits)

features.title: Approve, mark ready, edit title and change base branch of a PR
features.why: `pr_approve` (REST review pinned to head_oid), `pr_mark_ready`, `pr_edit` and `pr_retarget` are registered in lib.rs and wrap gh.rs, which matches NOTES. No `invoke` of any of them exists in src/, and there is no UI for approve, mark ready, edit title or change base.
features.obligation: Add the header and PR-menu actions Approve (when header_state offers it), Mark ready, Edit title and Change base branch, calling the registered commands and refreshing pr_lookup afterwards.

features.title: Start an AI code review with a configurable review model
features.why: The Review button is mounted in the right-panel tab strip (WorkspaceView.tsx:270,474) with Edit before sending and Cmd+Shift+R; it reads custom_prompt_code_review through the registered db_repo_prompt (lib.rs:296), picks models.review or opus-5-1m with the review effort, and opens a 'Review N' chat sending 'Review request.md' as an attachment through reason_open_chat config / reason_prompt attachments (#301). Review still shows on the Checks tab, there is no detached-HEAD refusal or read-only gating, findings are chat text not inline diff comments, and review tabs are lost on restart.
features.obligation: Hide Review on the Checks tab, refuse on detached HEAD, gate read-only workspaces, land findings as inline diff comments, persist review tabs.
anchors: copy /get an ai code review/ (2 hits)

features.title: Resolve merge conflicts with the agent; block actions while a merge or rebase is in progress
features.why: diff::git::workspace_diff returns OperationInProgress ('a merge is in progress; finish it to see changes'), and useWorkspaceDiff shows that message, so the diff is blocked during a merge or rebase. This matches the 'finish rebasing or merging to see changes' anchor. There is no Resolve conflicts action or prompt: header.rs MergeConflicts is unused by the UI, and custom_prompt_resolve_merge_conflicts is never read. No other PR actions are blocked during an operation.
features.obligation: Add the Resolve conflicts header action, shown when header_state returns MergeConflicts or a merge or rebase is in progress, that sends the resolve-conflicts prompt (with the repo custom prompt) to the agent, and block the other git and PR actions while the operation runs.
anchors: copy /finish rebasing or merging to see changes/ (2 hits)

features.title: Create a workspace from an existing PR, branch or issue, with PR search
features.why: App.tsx mounts CreateWorkspaceDialog, whose CreateFromPicker has a 'Pull requests' tab filled by the registered pr_list_open (bundled gh, list.rs), and gh_issue_list_open fills the Issues tab. Choosing a PR sends existingBranch and prNumber to create_workspace, which fetches pull/<n>/head for forks. Search only filters the first 100 open PRs on the client (createFrom.ts `matches`). A pasted PR outside that list gives 'Could not load that pull request', because NOTES confirms the reference's server-side search/issues and pulls/{n} lookup were not built.
features.obligation: Add search-as-you-type over all PRs (gh search prs or search/issues) and by-number or URL lookup (gh pr view), then create the workspace from the result and link it to the PR.
anchors: copy /create new workspace from pr/ (1 hit)

features.title: View and merge a stack of dependent PRs
features.why: src-tauri and src/ have no stack model, merge-stack command or stack UI. NOTES lists stacked-PR header states and the stack exception to archive-on-merge as not modelled.
features.obligation: Model dependent PR stacks (fetch stack fields), show the stack view, and implement merge-stack with its failure state.
